page.title: Answer Engine Insights
page.subtitle: Analyze brand presence across AI platforms.

sectionScore.title: Visibility Score
sectionScore.subtitleBrand: Percentage of AI responses that mention your brand.
sectionScore.subtitleProduct: Share of eligible AI responses that mention at least one own product.
sectionScore.subtitleTopic: Own mention share per tracked topic across AI responses (aggregated by topic).
sectionScore.scoreTooltip: Your brand's mention rate across all AI responses in the selected date range. Calculated as (queries mentioning your brand / total queries) × 100%.
sectionScore.scoreTooltipProduct: Eligible AI responses mentioning at least one own product divided by all eligible AI responses under the same filters. Product visibility and product SOV use different denominators.
sectionScore.emptyState: No visibility data for this period.

sectionSov.title: Share of Voice
sectionSov.subtitleBrand: How mentions are distributed among your brand and competitors.
sectionSov.subtitleProduct: SOV comparison across own products in AI responses.
sectionSov.subtitleTopic: SOV comparison across tracked topics in AI responses.
sectionSov.sovTooltip: Distribution of brand mentions across all AI responses. Shows your brand's share compared to competitors in the selected date range.
sectionSov.leadingProductTooltip: The share of all own-product mentions contributed by the most-mentioned own product. The donut shows the mention share across products.
sectionSov.emptyState: No SOV data for this period.

sectionPosition.title: Average Position
sectionPosition.subtitle: Average ranking of your brand in AI-generated answers (lower is better).
sectionPosition.positionTooltip: Average ranking position when your brand is mentioned in AI responses. #1 means your brand appears first.
sectionPosition.emptyState: No position data for this period.

fullRankingDialog.title: Full Ranking
fullRankingDialog.description: Complete ranking of all brands in this period.

sectionShare.totalCitationsTooltip: Total number of source citations (URLs) found across all AI responses in the selected date range.
sectionShare.emptyState: No citation data for this period.

sectionCategories.title: Citation Categories

tooltips.viewByDimension: Switch the data aggregation dimension: Brand / Topic / Product. On the Channel Analysis page, these represent "channel × brand", "channel × topic", "channel × product" cross views; on other pages, they aggregate Visibility / Citation / Sentiment metrics by brand, topic, or product. The Product dimension only appears when products have been configured under a tracked topic.
tooltips.channelCooccurrence: The number of times a single AI answer mentions both a shadow channel brand and one of your own products. This is the core metric for OEM / reseller sales modes — it reflects your product's visibility in the channel context.
tooltips.channelOtherProducts: Other products AI recommends on the shadow channel (not yours). Broken down into: channel's own brand line / channel reselling others. Helps you assess the competitive landscape on this channel.
tooltips.citationRole: Citation source types: your own website / your product pages on shadow channels / other pages on shadow channels / standalone peer sites / third-party media reviews.
tooltips.peerVoiceShare: Share-of-voice comparison across all brands marked as peers, including brands that are also your shadow channels (e.g. Rough Country, when it's both a channel and a peer, is included).
